why.delivery: A delivery outcome row: the driver records what was delivered; no model call is launched, so there is no session and no money.
why.launched: The START of a model call whose end row follows it; it has no session and no money of its own, the end row carries both.
why.gate_repair: Round bookkeeping in front of a gate: the row carries no session and no money of its own. A round can dispatch a role (qa-case-critic or qa-case-designer), but that call is journalled by its own run_claude end row, which counts if it has no session.
why.trace_failed: Records that a deterministic factory script failed; no model is started by the writers, and the row has no session or cost.
why.rows_given_up: Bookkeeping: owed journal rows given up on the person's word; no call, no session, no money.
why.stopped_by_person: A Ctrl-C record listing the calls the person cut off; the row itself has no session, cost or exit code.
why.note: A host fact written during a call; the call's money is on its own run_claude end row, which counts if it has no session.
why.window_round: Round bookkeeping of a rework window (driver_machine.window_round_gate): the row carries no session and no money of its own; the conductor call a round precedes is journalled by its own row, which counts if it has no session.
why.repeat_stop: Repeat bookkeeping (Driver.record_repeat): no session, no money of its own.
why.process: The driver's own process start and end rows (P1-v, driver_journal.process_start_row / process_end_row): the row launches no model call and carries no session and no money; its end key is process_code, never exit_code.
